problems: Four dossiers repaired and re-validated (0 errors): county-of-osona, county-of-ampuria, taifa-of-badajoz, taifa-of-denia. taifa-of-alpuente passed review and was not touched. 10 reviewer findings applied (Osona 1, Ampuria 3, Badajoz 2, Dénia 4); the reviewer's own three in-place fixes were kept.
County of Manresa and County of Peralada (Pedralbes) are dropped from counterparts_needing_dossiers: the pages treat them as parts of Osona and Empúries.

Disagreements with the review: Alzira and Xàtiva are not in the gazetteer (resolver: unknown place), so taifa-of-denia now has resolve warnings for them; the judicates' 1015 shapes are 12 (Logudoro) and 2 (Gallura) cells, not 27 and 14; Osona keyframe _798 ends 825, not 826, so the loss year is the first year not drawn.

Routing to other batches: county-of-berga needs a 990 gain of the pagus of Berga from county-of-osona; county-of-barcelona a 1111 gain of Osona; county-of-rosellon a merge 817 and split 989 with county-of-ampuria and a contest 1014-1019; crown-of-aragon a 1410 gain of Empúries; kingdom-of-leon a 1055 gain of the Beira strip (minus the Coimbra district), a vassal_start for taifa-of-badajoz in 1055 and the 1064 gain of Coimbra; caliphate-of-cordoba a 1015 loss of the Balearic Islands to taifa-of-denia (new, counterpart was nobody); taifa-of-valencia an occupation_start 1017 and occupation_end 1021 by taifa-of-denia (southern part of the taifa); giudicato-of-logudoro and giudicato-of-gallura (eu-13) occupation_start 1015 and occupation_end 1016 by taifa-of-denia (new, previously a text counterpart); taifa-of-zaragoza a 1076 gain of the Dénia mainland; af-02: almoravid-dynasty a 1106 gain of Alpuente, almohad-caliphate a 1150 gain of Badajoz and a 1224 loss to taifa-of-denia.
